text_block_list.text:
I was participating in a mountain camp 
training session alongside <chrname>, but...

When lunchtime came, I realized a painful 
mistake. I turned my backpack inside out, 
but it was nowhere to be found――

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, are you alright? If it's fine with 
you, I can prepare that for you...
choice_data_list: Wait, thank you! That's a lifesaver...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's right over that way, so please follow 
me!

It seems she's willing to lend me some 
tableware. Breathing a sigh of relief, I 
follow her to where her luggage is 
stored――

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
――Here we are! Now then, which bamboo 
shoot would you like?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Do you have a specific size in mind 
for the dishware you'd like to make?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
? Um... you forgot your tableware, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! The bamboo in this grove is cleared 
for cutting, so please don't worry!

No, that is not what I mean. However, we 
have no choice but to rely on her right 
now.
choice_data_list: Th-Then... let's go with that bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
As for what we need: cups, plates, bowls, 
and chopsticks, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first I'll make a plate from this 
joint around here... and maybe turn this 
section into a cup.
(Saw saw...) (Crack!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—How is this? Are there any issues on your 
end?
choice_data_list:
Not a problem at all! That was 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you get the chance, please try making 
some yourself♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Calling me a teacher is way too 
much! I just learned it from the grandpas 
back home.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm honored to be of help. 
...Wisdom really is handed down like this, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I was raised in the mountains, so I 
can at least manage this much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you ever find yourself in trouble 
again, please don't hesitate to reach out!
